subject: Garden Rule Standardization and Waitlist Management
overview: The Commission reviewed end-of-season reports for city gardens and discussed standardizing rules to address plot abandonment and gardener removals. Members also considered new applications and proposed off-season workshops on seed starting and irrigation.

items.title: Winthrop Garden Season Wrap-up
items.summary: Decided against a temporary gardener cap while continuing to split larger plots to reduce the waitlist.

items.title: Tufts Park Garden Fence Issues
items.summary: Discussed pressuring the city to replace a garden fence that was damaged by a municipal tow truck several years ago.

items.title: Barry Park Garden Improvements
items.summary: Reported that the Barry Park garden shed has been installed and is scheduled for painting.

items.title: Riverbend Garden Season Wrap-up
items.summary: Reported the end of the season and noted several incidents where entire plants were stolen from plots.

items.title: McNally Garden Updates
items.summary: Reassigned a vacant plot to a gardener from the pop-up location and reviewed plot-sharing options for long-term gardeners.

items.title: Andrews Middle School Collaboration
items.summary: Acknowledged ongoing coordination challenges regarding student involvement and the repair of damaged planters at the middle school.

items.title: Commission Membership and Governance
items.summary: Reviewed applications for open seats and discussed the requirement for all voting members to be sworn in and complete ethics training.

items.title: Bylaw Revisions and Three-Strike Policy
items.summary: Discussed standardizing rules across all gardens, including a 'three strikes' policy to provide documentation when removing non-compliant gardeners.

items.title: Off-season Event Proposals
items.summary: Proposed holding winter workshops on seed swaps, native plant sowing, and terracotta 'Oya' irrigation systems.

items.title: History of Medford Community Gardens
items.summary: Reviewed the history of the three-year waitlist limit and the political challenges of securing public land for garden use.
